question: Which of the following reactions of drug metabolism corresponds to phase II ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Conjugation with amino acids -> Phase II drug metabolism -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: Hydrolysis of the ester group -> Phase I drug metabolism -> Aromatic hydroxylation -> Phase II drug metabolism -> 95%
analysis: Phase II reactions involve conjugation of the drug or its metabolites with endogenous compounds to increase water solubility and facilitate excretion. Conjugation with amino acids is a typical Phase II reaction.
